input: Label and archive all work project files by client

gold.taskTitle: Label and Archive Work Project Files by Client
gold.taskDescription: Organise all existing work project files by applying consistent labels and archiving them into a structured system sorted by client.

questions.title: Where are the files currently stored?
questions.description: Identify the location of the files, such as a local hard drive, cloud storage like Google Drive or Dropbox, or a company server.

questions.title: How many clients do these files span?
questions.description: Determine the number of distinct clients involved so the scope of the archiving work is clear.

questions.title: What file types are included in these project files?
questions.description: Clarify whether the files are documents, spreadsheets, images, videos, emails, or a mix of formats.

questions.title: What naming convention should the labels follow?
questions.description: Establish whether there is a preferred format for file and folder names, such as ClientName_ProjectName_Date or another structure.

questions.title: Should completed and active projects be separated?
questions.description: Determine whether ongoing projects need to be distinguished from finished ones in the archive structure.

questions.title: Is there a deadline for completing this archive?
questions.description: Find out if there is a specific date or urgency driving when this task needs to be finished.

questions.title: Who else needs access to the archived files?
questions.description: Clarify whether the archive is for personal use only or must be accessible to a team, affecting folder structure and permissions.
